scope: Only original pre-write cutMesh witness IDs/coordinates. No native C++/mesh/binary mutation or solver/checker execution. Serial native meshing is an API diagnostic, not a serial solver run or product acceptance.

nativeRecordAudit.scope: Native pre-write IDs, not final polyMesh IDs. Complete packet list can establish proposal compatibility; limited star cannot establish whole-component geometry. Coupled remote centres remain unavailable.
nativeRecordAudit.geometryNotEvaluated: Partial component or conflicting proposals: applying a partial/arbitrary displacement could create spurious geometry.

completeProposalLocalTrial.scope: A local failure is sufficient to reject this displacement. Partial cells, missing one-ring neighbours and uncomputed quality gates cannot establish whole-component acceptance.
completeProposalLocalTrial.notEvaluated: Conflicting displacement constraints (including source-reported conflicts outside the sample) or missing point records.

exactNativeTriggerAudit.scope: This is one sufficient point conflict, not all global conflicts.
